inputs.xtext_rule_text:
OwnedDisjoining returns SysML::Disjoining :
	  disjoiningType = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain
;

decision: As KerML 8.2.4.1.4 states it: the disjoining type, either as a cross-reference `[QualifiedName]` or as a FeatureChain owned by the relationship. The clause writes FeatureChain where the Xtext writes OwnedFeatureChain. KerML 8.2.4.3.5 defines `OwnedFeatureChain : Feature = FeatureChain`, so the two accept exactly the same tokens, and the rule follows the clause. The same clause's Disjoining production writes FeatureChain in both of its positions.

evidence.note: OwnedDisjoining : Disjoining = disjoiningType = [QualifiedName] | disjoiningType = FeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += disjoiningType }
OwnedFeatureChain : Feature = FeatureChain, which makes the Xtext's alternative token-identical to the clause's
line 31: `... disjoint from h1;`, the QualifiedName alternative
OwnedDisjoining: disjoiningType = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName] | ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain. The same tokens.

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the kerml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in OwnedDisjoining@kerml
